text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting solid gains with Ethereum outpacing Bitcoin, suggesting moderate risk appetite beyond just the largest asset. The Fear & Greed index sitting at neutral (50) with a slight downward drift indicates traders are neither particularly confident nor panicked, consistent with a consolidation phase rather than euphoria or capitulation. Bitcoin dominance holding at 59.6% and volume at $88B reflects steady participation without extreme concentration of capital into alternative assets.
